shared_elements: low-relief carved surface with symbolic signs
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief symbolic carving including a prominent ring/disc motif and curving band-like elements, and both involve human/anthropomorphic representation, but these are generic correspondences. A is a dense multi-figure narrative scene of seated persons flanking a central tree within a scrolled border, while B is a single monumental standing figure whose back bears sparse, isolated abstract motifs with no interacting figures or framing band.
